prerequisites.name: Bun and native SQLite
prerequisites.verificationCommand: cd /data/project && bun -e "import {Database} from 'bun:sqlite'; const d=new Database(':memory:'); if(d.query('select 1 as n').get().n!==1)process.exit(1);d.close();"

prerequisites.name: Application database schema
prerequisites.reason: Owner-scoped conversation, source and assessment persistence
prerequisites.verificationCommand: cd /data/project && bun -e "import {db} from './src/config/db.ts';import {ventureMessages,ventureSources,ventureConversations,ventureAssessments} from './src/db/schema/venture.ts';for(const t of [ventureMessages,ventureSources,ventureConversations,ventureAssessments])await db.select().from(t).limit(1);"

prerequisites.name: Chromium headless browser
prerequisites.reason: Responsive report navigation, reload, failure preservation
prerequisites.verificationCommand: cd /data/project && bun -e "import {chromium} from 'playwright-core';const b=await chromium.launch({executablePath:'/usr/bin/chromium',headless:true,args:['--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage']});try{const p=await b.newPage();await p.goto('data:text/html,<title>capability</title>');if(await p.title()!=='capability')process.exitCode=1;}finally{await b.close();}"
